target.title: fix(codex): suppress raw commentary echo when phase field is absent
target.body:
## Summary

**Problem**: The Codex app-server may ship a raw response echo for a commentary item without including the `phase` field. Current main only consumes the `pendingRawCommentaryEchoes` counter when `phase === "commentary"` (event-projector.ts:957). An unphased raw assistant item falls through to `extractRawAssistantText` → `assistantTextByItem`, making commentary/debug text eligible as visible final output in WebChat.

**Solution**: Add a guard after the existing `phase === "commentary"` check: when the raw item has no `phase` but a typed commentary echo is pending, decrement the counter and suppress the item. Follows the same "one typed → one raw" pairing contract.

**What changed**: `event-projector.ts` +9 (new guard), `event-projector.test.ts` +69 (regression test).

**What did NOT change**: Existing `phase === "commentary"` guard. `extractRawAssistantText`. Counter lifecycle.

Fixes #89668

## What Problem This Solves

WebChat users see Codex commentary/debug text leaked into visible assistant replies. The Codex protocol declares `phase` as optional — the app-server may ship raw echoes without it, bypassing the existing dedup.

## Root Cause

`codex-rs/protocol/src/models.rs:891` — `MessagePhase` optional. `event-projector.ts:957` — only matches `phase === "commentary"`. Unphased items fall through to `extractRawAssistantText` → eligible as visible final output at line 1793.

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed**: Codex raw commentary echo text leaks into visible assistant output when `phase` is absent from the raw response envelope.

**Real environment tested**: Node 24.13.1, Linux x86_64. PR head at `8db9c33989`. The `CodexAppServerEventProjector` test exercises the full Codex app-server notification lifecycle with payloads matching the real protocol shape.

**Exact steps or command run after this patch**: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts` — 99 tests exercising the projector lifecycle.

**After-fix evidence**:
```bash
# node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts
# verify the #89668 fix — unphased raw commentary echo suppressed,
# later raw-only note delivered correctly in final output
[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.extension-codex.config.ts

RUN  v4.1.8  |  Node 24.13.1  |  Linux x86_64

✓ CodexAppServerEventProjector > suppresses a raw commentary echo
  whose phase field is missing from the envelope
✓ CodexAppServerEventProjector > clears a pending commentary echo
  when the raw envelope has no text
✓ CodexAppServerEventProjector > delivers a later raw-only
  commentary note after consuming a same-text typed echo

Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  99 passed (99)
     Duration  20.33s (transform 10.50s, setup 638ms, tests 1.43s)
```

**Observed result after the fix**: The unphased raw commentary echo is consumed by `pendingRawCommentaryEchoes` and suppressed — no preamble emitted, not stored in `assistantTexts`. A later unphased raw-only note is correctly delivered as final output, proving the counter lifecycle is correct (typed increment → one raw decrement → next items unaffected). The guard sits at `event-projector.ts:966` directly below the existing `phase === "commentary"` check.

**What was not tested**: Live WebChat/gateway session with real Codex app-server. No Codex runtime is available. The fix is proven via source-level analysis: the Codex protocol declares `phase` optional (verified in `codex-rs/protocol/src/models.rs:891`), the test payloads match the real notification shape, and the guard follows the same pattern as the existing check two lines above.

**Evidence provenance**: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs` on PR head at Node 24.13 / Linux x86_64, 2026-07-02.

## Evidence

### Before/After code path analysis

**BEFORE (current main, event-projector.ts:957)**:
```
handleRawResponseItemCompleted(item):
  phase = readString(item, "phase")       // undefined (field absent)
  if (phase === "commentary" && ...)      // false — undefined !== "commentary"
  // Falls through — reads text → stores in assistantTextByItem
  // Commentary text now eligible as visible output (line 1793)
```

**AFTER (PR head, +9 lines at event-projector.ts:961-969)**:
```
handleRawResponseItemCompleted(item):
  phase = readString(item, "phase")       // undefined (field absent)
  if (phase === "commentary" && ...)      // false
  if (!phase && pendingRawCommentaryEchoes > 0)  // true ← NEW GUARD
    pendingRawCommentaryEchoes -= 1
    return                                // echo suppressed, counter consumed
  // Real raw-only notes (no typed echo pending) pass through
```

### Regression test verification

The test (`event-projector.test.ts:1450`) sends: typed commentary completion → raw echo without phase → later raw-only note. Asserts: (1) only typed-echo preamble emitted (raw echo suppressed); (2) later raw note appears in `assistantTexts` (counter lifecycle correct); (3) 99/99 total tests pass with zero regressions.

### Codex protocol contract

- `codex-rs/protocol/src/models.rs:891` — `MessagePhase` optionally serialized
- `codex-rs/app-server-protocol/schema/typescript/ResponseItem.ts:15` — `phase?: MessagePhase`
- `event-projector.ts:1793` — final output skips `phase === "commentary"` only (unphased bypasses)

## Risk checklist

**Highest-risk area**: Guard suppresses by counter alone. A non-commentary raw item without `phase` could be suppressed if a commentary completion is pending. Commentary completions are echo-immediate; same risk exists for the phased guard above.

**Risk level**: Low — mirrors existing guard. Counter lifecycle unchanged. 99/99 tests pass.

**Merge risk declaration**: No merge risk. Additive guard in single Codex plugin file.

## Design Decisions

**Why a separate guard?** Merging `phase === "commentary" || (!phase && count > 0)` would consume counter when phase is explicitly non-commentary. Separate guards make intent clear.

**Why not check text content?** The phased guard doesn't either — symmetric "one typed → one raw" pairing.
